projects.ctaText: Have a project in mind? Let's discuss!

projects_data.noobzap_desc:
Noobzap is a satirical parody magazine among friends, integrating AI to generate and rewrite articles in a unique tone. It uses a detailed knowledge base to personalize each person's anecdotes and chronicles.

Key points:
• AI Generation: Automatic rewriting and completion of parody articles.
• Knowledge Base: Integration of detailed profiles to enrich content with relevant information.
• Newspaper Aesthetic: Immersive design adopting the codes of satirical newspapers.
• Web Platform: Dynamic frontend development with Next.js and React.
projects_data.love4you_desc:
Love4You is an innovative mobile application designed to boost a couple's life through a fun and interactive experience. Based on an advanced gamification system, it offers various game modules (quizzes, challenges, role-playing games) and daily quests to encourage engagement and retention.

Key points:
• Conception & Design: Writing the PRD, interactive prototyping in Figma, and defining the product roadmap.
• Connected Ecosystem: Developing a Flutter application and a Next.js showcase site.
• Gamification & Loyalty: Implementing varied game modules and retention mechanics (Daily Quests, Streaks).
• Marketing & Tests: Social media presence strategy, creation of visual assets (Canva), and validation via Firebase (Test Lab, Remote Config).
projects_data.discoverpicture_desc:
DiscoverPicture transforms photo sharing into an interactive digital treasure hunt. Instead of just sending files, create albums where each memory is locked behind a secret QR code. A fun, secure, and entirely local experience to rediscover your precious moments.

Key points:
• Treasure Hunt Concept: Photo unlocking system by scanning unique QR codes.
• Total Privacy: 100% local architecture, no data is sent or stored in the cloud.
• Native Security: Integrated protection against screenshots to preserve the privacy of memories.
• Offline Mode: Full operation without internet connection for scanning and viewing.
• Material Design 3 UI: Modern and intuitive interface using Google's latest design standards.
projects_data.motionparty_desc: Interactive game for seniors using the PC camera to transform the body into a controller.
projects_data.auraenglish_desc:
Aura English is a modern and intelligent mobile application dedicated to learning English. It combines the power of AI (Google Gemini) with proven learning methods such as Spaced Repetition via the SM-2 algorithm.

Key points:
• AI Generation: Automatic question creation and correction via the Gemini API.
• Review System (SRS): SM-2 algorithm to schedule reviews at the ideal time.
• Rich Content: Over 20 integrated decks covering CEFR levels from A1 to C2.
• Sharing & Community: Import/Export of decks in JSON and simplified sharing via QR codes.
• Offline Mode: Offline-first architecture with SQLite local storage and OTA updates.
projects_data.nexus_desc:
Nexus is a multi-functional bot designed to boost interactions between members of a Discord server. Combining entertainment and administration tools, it stands out with a robust DevOps-oriented architecture.

Key points:
• Community Engagement: Over 30 game commands (Russian roulette, dice, hangman, battleship, oxo) and an advanced curse system to reinforce interaction.
• Infrastructure & Keep-Alive: Integrated Express.js server to ensure 24/7 online maintenance on platforms like Render or Replit.
• Code Quality: Use of Jest for unit testing and ESLint for static analysis, ensuring high stability.
• CI/CD: Full automation of tests and linting via GitHub Actions.
projects_data.belleariane_desc: Online shop specializing in jewelry (activity ceased in January 2023). The project included full defining of the graphic charter and Moodboard, e-commerce site design, SEO optimization, product photography, and visual montage.
projects_data.phantomposture_desc: Non-intrusive mobile application designed to help users correct and maintain a healthy posture daily. Intelligent notification system with discreet reminders and posture validation without opening the application. Fully customizable (frequency and schedules) to adapt to your routine.
projects_data.geq_desc:
Complete web application to administer and calculate the Game Experience Questionnaire (GEQ) in French and English. This tool is designed to facilitate academic and industrial research by automating data processing.

Key points:
• Automated Calculation: Implementation of the official scoring method developed by Eindhoven University of Technology.
• Bilingual & Accessible: Modern interface fully localized (FR/EN) for international use.
• Research Standard: Standardized tool used to scientifically evaluate user experience (UX) in video games.
• Ease of Use: Allows rapid collection of responses without requiring manual post-form treatment.
projects_data.grignotons_desc:
Redesign of a family breeding site. Complete modernization of the interface while maintaining familiar navigation for the client, who is not very comfortable with technology.

Key points:
• Modernization: Transition from an obsolete design to a modern stack (Next.js, Tailwind CSS) while respecting the user's navigation habits.
• Simplicity: Implementation of a custom Sanity dashboard, extremely simplified for intuitive content management by the client.
• Accessibility: Strict respect for design and accessibility rules of the Public Service of Wallonia (SPW).
• Performance: Site optimized for performance and SEO, ensuring an effective web presence for a local breeder.
projects_data.go4success_desc:
Developed during my studies at UNamur, Go4Success is a success aid workshop platform intended for the UCL campus. Designed to be multi-platform (Android, iOS, Web) and open source, it meets strict requirements for maintainability, security, and availability for future developers.

Key points:
• Multi-platform Architecture: Development of a unique solution accessible on mobile and web.
• Methodology & DevOps: Use of Docker for orchestration and implementation of Agile/DevOps workflows.
• Security & API: Secure authentication via JWT and communication via a robust REST API (Django REST Framework).
• Frontend Performance: State management and optimized querying with React Native and TanStack.
projects_data.kinectkata_desc:
Position validation system based on angles for KATA in the martial art of Aikido. Bones angles of predefined KATA upper body are recorded in a list. The system uses Kinect sensors to estimate body joint coordinates and calculate bone angles. If angles match the tested position, it is validated.

Key points:
• Kinect SDK 2.0: Extensive use of the SDK for real-time skeletal tracking.
• Biometric Validation: Angle calculation algorithm to validate the correctness of Aikido movements.
• Optimization: Work on recognition despite loose clothing typical of martial arts.
projects_data.eanacarde_desc:
Large-scale university project intended for the cashew market in Benin, allowing full traceability of cashew nuts from harvest to sale. The platform manages two transaction systems: direct purchase and auctions, while offering advanced management tools for cooperatives and stocks.

Key points:
• Full Management: Modules dedicated to fields, stocks, bags, cooperatives, and sales (market).
• Admin Dashboard: Advanced dashboard for global system and user management.
• Rigorous Analysis: Design based on use cases, sequence and activity diagrams with full API documentation.
• Internationalization: Multi-language support and responsive design adapted to local constraints.
• Modern Stack: Robust architecture with Spring Boot, Angular, and PostgreSQL, orchestrated by Docker.
